preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Close the automatic-combat causality defect and advance the world/objective presentation family across camera framing, cemetery spatial integrity, animation/VFX/lighting/audio readability, and accessible product-shell choices.

diagnosis.root_cause: Two independent product families remain below contract: automatic lantern attacks resolve authoritatively but emit no audible Effects source/output, while the authored-world gameplay camera leaves the Warden too small and low as the mausoleum dominates the frame.

stop_conditions: Implement exactly the two bounded families below and cover every required gap exactly once.
Preserve the native Godot project, first-run guidance flow and image, Montserrat typography, authored cemetery package, and three distinct weapon resources.
Stop when candidate changes enable direct host recapture and Tester retest; do not claim issue or phase closure in the plan.

strategy.rationale: Separate the independent combat-audio repair from the world/objective presentation family required by the host grouping. Use adapter/event-routing repair for audio and authored camera/anchor/composition integration for the world surface, avoiding another undifferentiated camera-tuning pass.

code: Run parser and resource-load checks on all edited scripts, scenes, and resources; preserve validate:host_godot_boot and validate:native_godot_project.

White-box verify one authoritative lantern attack maps to one bounded audio emission; camera follow remains high-angle/damped; authored landmark collision and anchors share transforms; upgrade cards derive truthful values and focus state from authoritative data.
Verify preserved guidance, typography, map meshes, and weapon resources remain intact and un-split.
runtime: For task:automatic_combat_audio_causality, host runs runtime_audio_causality_probe for one ordinary attack and adjacent hit window, then Tester reruns validate:authored_world_presentation_automatic_combat_causality_contract.

For task:world_objective_presentation, host runs movement_effect_capture and spatial_coordinate_probe at spawn, critical route, landmark/cardinal, near-contact/departure, ordinary movement, and dash; Tester reruns validate:authored_world_presentation_camera_movement_dash_contract and validate:authored_world_presentation_authored_cemetery_composition_contract.

Host recaptures animation/VFX/lighting/audio density and title, settings, upgrade, pause, result, retry, and focus states across required devices/scales; Tester reruns validate:authored_world_presentation_animation_vfx_lighting_audio_contract and validate:authored_world_presentation_product_shell_accessibility_contract.
Bind all fresh captures, runtime state, transforms, logs, and audio timelines to this candidate before Tester judgment.
visual: Compare shipped gameplay views to the bound Mournlight reference for readable Warden and threat silhouettes, escape lanes, warm-versus-cool lighting, cemetery depth, grounded landmarks, and absence of occlusion/disappearance drift.

Inspect level-up and product-shell views for authored silhouettes/icons, truthful deltas, restrained copy, full-viewport composition, and complete focus states; inspect dense combat for distinct causal VFX/audio and preserved telegraphs.

done_when: One ordinary automatic Warden Lantern attack produces a complete causal chain from cooldown-ready target through emitted attack, hit/damage resolution, and audible anticipation, onset, impact, and recovery cues.
The same attack emits exactly one bounded player-report source event on the Effects bus with a non-silent mixed waveform; no duplicate report or long ringing material cue masks it.
Host can recapture the attack window with authoritative attack receipts, source-event timing, and mixed-output audio for direct Tester closure of the audio issue.
tasks.instructions: Repair only the product-owned automatic-combat feedback path. Trace authoritative lantern attack authorization, emission, hit, and damage into one semantic audio owner; bind a short recognizable anticipation/onset/impact/recovery presentation to the Effects bus, enforce bounded lifecycle and deduplication, and keep projectile/impact VFX and character-hit feedback distinct. Use a differential same-bus control if needed, preserve source recordings and preserved weapon resources, and add only candidate-side receipts needed for host recapture. Do not alter camera, map geometry, HUD, or unrelated product families.
tasks.title: Restore automatic lantern audio causality

done_when: The shipped high-angle camera keeps the Warden, nearby threats/projectiles/pickups, and at least one escape lane readable; damping, dash anticipation/onset/recovery/cooldown/invulnerability, and pause/resume remain stable without FPS/TPS drift.

Movement replay demonstrates larger traversable scale, coherent external world depth, a visible central building/landmark, aligned collision, no disappearance or occlusion during approach/contact/departure, and a stable perimeter/boundary under ordinary movement; the Warden and representative enemies cannot pass through the landmark or become trapped.

The authored-world presentation has readable idle, locomotion, attack/cast, hurt, death, dash, victory, pickup, weapon, enemy-warning, and boss-phase feedback with coherent moonlit/lantern lighting, restrained VFX, bounded semantic audio layers, and no telegraph burial at dense play.

Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with a clear visual hierarchy led by authored weapon/upgrade silhouettes and compact stat icons; show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, omit unchanged or exhaustive rows, never show NEW or LOCKED as a CURRENT placeholder, and expose complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, and un?

Title, settings, pause, result, retry, and title-return pages fill the viewport, preserve focus and pause ownership, and persist required audio, window, UI-scale, shake/flash, damage-number, and targeting settings across restart.
Host can recapture spawn, critical-route, landmark/cardinal, near-contact/departure, ordinary movement/dash, level-up, and product-shell focus states for direct Tester review.
tasks.instructions: Repair the world/objective presentation family around the intact authored cemetery. Rework camera/composition ownership and additive spawn, objective, navigation, collision, and boundary anchors so the Warden remains readable while threats, an escape lane, external world depth, and central landmarks remain visible. Verify the central building/mausoleum collision and perimeter through ordinary movement, dash, near-contact, and departure replay; never replace, duplicate, hide, split, or reposition authored child meshes. In the same family, complete authored animation/VFX/lighting/audio readability and the product shell: replace text-stacked upgrade cards with visual hierarchy, silhouettes, compact icons, truthful current-to-new values (maximum three deltas), and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states; keep HUD and full-screen pages authored, readable, and settings-persistent. Preserve accepted source assets and authoritative gameplay truth.
tasks.title: Restore world framing and objective presentation
